slice: AVI-MOVI-003 tag identity exact proof slice (not the whole Issue and not all of AVI-MOVI-003)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.avi_movi_003_tag_identity: full [u8;4] chunk id; all 2^32 bit patterns. ASCII digit prefixes, non-digit prefixes, known/unknown/opaque kind suffixes, and non-ASCII kind bytes are not sampled or narrowed
input_domain.production_representation: the symbolic array is the same [u8;4] chunk id representation returned by production Chunks::next and passed by the movi loop
input_domain.excluded_inputs: none within the tag input domain. Packet body bytes, chunk sizes, nested LIST structure, stream declarations, and timing inputs are outside this sub-boundary rather than narrowed tag inputs

assume_classification: No kani::assume and no input narrowing. Branching on digit/non-digit inside the proof is exact complement branch selection, not an assumption. Kind bytes are opaque because that is the current production contract.

coverage.acceptance_exact_complement: accepted iff id[0] and id[1] are both ASCII digits; rejected otherwise regardless of id[2]/id[3]
coverage.kind_preservation: accepted tags preserve kind[0]==id[2] and kind[1]==id[3] in order, including unknown/opaque/non-ASCII suffix bytes
coverage.arithmetic_safety: digit subtraction and decimal composition are checked for overflow/underflow/panic freedom over the full input domain
coverage.production_connection: the production movi loop calls avi_movi_packet_tag with the same inner chunk id returned by Chunks::next and does not duplicate digit classification, stream number arithmetic, or kind extraction
coverage.boundary_connection: packet body boundary/padding remains the separate AVI-CHUNK-001 layer proved by avi_chunk_step_exact in PR #284; this slice does not reprove or weaken that layer

initial_lane_before_mutation.note: initial cold-cache pass retained as auxiliary evidence; final canonical lane is kani/ after mutation revert

mutation.description: temporary production mutation swapped the stream number tens and ones digits in avi_movi_packet_tag
mutation.expected_detection: avi-movi-tag proof must fail; generic boundary-only failures or diagnostic-payload-only mutations are not accepted as tag oracle evidence
mutation.revert: mutation reverted exactly; final avi-movi-tag lane, mise run test al-media, and mise run test-formal passed after revert

mp4-avi-boundary.note: PR #284 proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented

mp4-scan.note: PR #285 proof was not redesigned or reimplemented

wav-chunk-scan.note: PR #283 proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented

wav-range.note: PR #282 proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented

unproven_scope.avi_movi_003_remainder: nested movi/list composition, rec/OpenDML semantics, stream declaration correspondence, stream existence, kind validity/meaning classification, packet body boundary plus tag composition, and Vec<MoviPacket> collection
unproven_scope.avi_time_004: dwStart offset, u128 division, remainder, independent stream clocks, multi-packet accumulation
unproven_scope.integration: I/O, allocation, Vec decode, diagnostic formatting, public API whole-call no-panic, writer round-trip, corruption whole-call proof, partial ingest behavior
unproven_scope.other_containers: MP4-TABLE-005, MP4-PCM, signature reconstruction, and all MP4 properties outside regression proofs

limited_cost_comparison.scope: AVI movi/container walk related legacy whole-call proofs only; not the complete old/new cost matrix

legacy.canonical_1500s: timeout; /usr/bin/time max RSS unavailable because SIGTERM

limited_cost_comparison.new_proof: avi_movi_packet_tag_exact final lane 3869ms / 245780KiB; initial cold-cache lane 9514ms / 315484KiB
limited_cost_comparison.comparison_note: The legacy proofs include writer fixtures, container decode, allocation, formatting, and parser-wide branches and did not produce a formal pass. The new proof is narrower: scalar tag identity only. The lower reruns cost is not evidence of equivalent assurance.

proptest_overlap.added: small deterministic avi.rs regressions for 00wb/99dc digit boundaries, non-digit first/second prefixes, unknown/opaque suffixes, kind byte order, non-frame pc preservation, and production movi loop connection; formal_containers.rs unchanged
proptest_overlap.relationship: proptest exercises public integration statistically; Kani proves scalar movi tag identity exhaustively over the full [u8;4] domain

legacy_disposition: No legacy whole-call/container proof was retired in this slice. Retire decisions remain for a later slice with coordinator approval and replacement coverage.
